**Domain Boundaries**: If a ghost cell coincides with the boundary of the domain, there is no need to connect to other grids.
No ghost data is needed or generated for these edges.
**Adjacent Box Values**: If a ghost cell coincides with the cell of an adjacent box (in the same level), the ghost cell must be filled with the value from that adjacent box.

**Coarse Parent Values**: If no neighboring box overlapping the ghost cell exists in the same level, the stitch cell (and thus the ghost cell) must be filled with the value from the cell it refines in the parent level ($i-1$).
Since a level is always completely contained in its parent level, such a cell always exists.

This ensures that several cells in the fine box (corresponding to the refinement ratio) are filled with the coarse grid value, simplifying look-up for connecting coarse grid values in stitch cell generation.
